summary: Shailendra Bhandare works in Indology, history, and archaeology. He has held positions at the British Museum as curator, the Fitzwilliam Museum on a fellowship, St Cross College as a Fellow (attested 2022), and the Ashmolean Museum as Assistant Keeper (attested 2006–2022).

Shailja Singh works in Indology and other fields. She completed an MBBS at Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Aligarh (2019–2025) and served as Concurrent Faculty at Jawaharlal Nehru University (attested 2026).

Shaman Hatley specializes in Indology and religious studies. He studied at Goddard College (~1994–1998) and the University of Pennsylvania (~2000–2007, PhD) under Harunaga Isaacson, Ludo Rocher, and Shrikant S. Bahulkar. He taught at Concordia University (~2007–2015) and joined UMass Boston in 2015.
Shan Shan Zhao is a scholar in Buddhist studies. She earned a Master of Arts at McMaster University, where she studied under James A. Benn, Shayne Clarke, and Mark Rowe.

Shanshan Jia works in Indology and Tibetology. She studied at the University of Hamburg as a doctoral student under Harunaga Isaacson (attested 2015, 2026) and served there as a Wissenschaftliche Projektmitarbeiterin (attested 2026).
Shantanu Nevrekar specializes in Indology and other fields. He pursued doctoral studies in anthropology at Stanford University (2019–2026) and served as Visiting Faculty at Ashoka University in 2026.
Shanti Bhikshu Shastri (1912–2003) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied under Friedrich Weller, taught Wilhelm Rau, and served on the research staff at Visva-Bharati University.
Shantu Barua specializes in Buddhist studies. He studied at Ryukoku University (attested 2015) and served as an Associate Professor at the University of Dhaka in 2020.

Shaoyong Ye is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He completed his doctoral studies at Peking University by 2009 under Qing Duan, and served on the faculty there, including as Associate Professor (attested 2010–2016, 2026).
Sharad Deshpande is a scholar in philosophy and Indology. He studied at Savitribai Phule Pune University (1972) and later served as a Professor there (attested 2026).
Sharon J. Roe works in religious studies and philosophy. She completed a PhD at the California Institute of Integral Studies under doctoral supervisor Steven D. Goodman (attested 2014).

Sharon Salzberg is a Buddhist studies and religious studies teacher. She attended the University at Buffalo (1969) and studied under teachers including Satya Narayan Goenka, Anagarika Munindra, and Mahasi Sayadaw. She co-founded the Insight Meditation Society (1974) and the Barre Center (1989).

Shashibhusan Dasgupta (1911–1964) specialized in philosophy, Indology, and religious studies. He studied at Brojomohun College, Scottish Church College, and the University of Calcutta (~1933–1939, MA and PhD), where he later served as a Lecturer (attested 1950).

Shayne Clarke specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at Bukkyo University, the University of Canterbury under Paul Harrison, and UCLA under Gregory Schopen. He serves at McMaster University (attested 2015–2026) and as a Research Fellow at IIBS (attested 2026).

Shechen Gyaltsab (1871–1926) was an authority in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under numerous teachers, including Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, and taught Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, among others.
Shechen Rabjam Rinpoche is a figure in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under spiritual teacher Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and founded Karuna-Shechen in 2000.

Sheila Jasanoff studied at Radcliffe College, the University of Bonn, Harvard University, and Harvard Law School. She held academic posts at Cornell University (~1978–1998) and Harvard University (~1998).

Shek-Wing Tam (1935–2024) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology specialist. He studied under Dudjom Rinpoche, Ying-Kuang Chu, and Yui Chi Lau. He founded the Sino-Tibetan Buddhist Studies Association in North America and was a professor at Renmin University (~2007–2012).

Sheldon Pollock is an Indology and linguistics scholar who earned his doctorate under Daniel H. H. Ingalls. He held professorships at the University of Iowa (~1977–1989), the University of Chicago (1990), and Columbia University (~2005–2021), where he became Professor Emeritus.

Sheng Yen (1931–2009) was a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Jing'an Temple Buddhist Academy and Rissho University (~1969–1975). He taught at National Cheng Kung University and Chung-Hwa Institute of Buddhist Studies, and founded Dharma Drum Mountain in 1989.
